svg.title: Separate end dates for workplace benefits before age 65
svg.desc: A timeline from the last day of work to the month after a 65th birthday. Drugs, dental, travel medical, and life conversion each have their own date. Provincial seniors drug plans do not start on the retirement date.
svg.text: Ontario drug start shown as an example. Your province differs. 26 Nov 2026.

g.text: Drugs: may end that day. Ontario Drug Benefit starts the first of the next month after 65.
Dental: often no provincial replacement. Waiting periods apply on a new individual plan.
Travel medical: usually ends with the job, including a trip already booked.
Life: conversion is a short contractual window, not the drug-plan date.
LTD: not portable just because a retiree health plan exists.

svg.text: Write five end dates. A pension start date is a sixth page, not this one.
